headline: Lack of women directors on the board of IOCL, which sells petrol and diesel, weighs heavily; NSE and BSE impose a hefty fine
summary: Indian Oil has been hit with a hefty fine by the NSE and BSE over the lack of women directors on its board. The company argues that appointment power rests with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
why: Indian Oil is India's largest state-run fuel retailer and refiner, and its governance is closely watched by exchanges and investors. Board composition rules apply to listed companies in India.
